# 🐾 CapyReporter
English | 简体中文
A local task reporter for DeepSeek Harness Web: a page pet, plus an optional transparent always-on-t
op Electron companion.
## What it reports
- Live **workspace + session** labels and a bounded **assistant milestone** preview: the collapsed b
ubble follows the assistant's latest statement instead of tool chatter. Reasoning stays hidden unles
s you opt in to *Report thinking*; switching it off discards live reasoning buffers, and completed p

reviews never retain reasoning. Prompts, tool arguments and tool output are never displayed.
- Separ
ate **completed, cancelled, failed, blocked, interrupted and output-limit** outcomes, using actual D

SH `turn/end` events. Idle alone is not success.
- **Running subagents are visible while they work.*
* The headline names them (`⏳ 1 running · 2 subagents — <chat>`) and, while the main chat has no fre
sh assistant text, the collapsed detail reads `🤖 2 subagents running`; the count drops as they finis

h and their progress milestones take over. Localized throughout.
- **Only the main chat claims a fin
ished turn.** Delegated subagent runs never raise the green *Turn complete* tick for the parent chat
: while a main chat is running the headline keeps showing it, and delegated finishes (`✅ Subagent fi
nished`, `⚠️ Subagent failed`, `⏹ Subagent cancelled`) appear as progress milestones in the details.

A main-chat result may only take the headline once no main chat is running.
- Independent unread re
sults for parallel sessions: starting another session does not erase a result. Up to 20 results are

retained in memory for six hours.
- Compact headlines and explicit **Details / Go to chat / Mute** c
ontrols, a top-right × close on the bubble, and pet-menu shortcuts that open settings or hand report

ing over to the always-on-top companion. Keyboard support and reduced-motion-safe styling.

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
0.6.27 was re-verified against **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.1** (routes, slots, client bundle serv
ing, and agent/session events). The only peer dependencies are `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `react`, wh
ich DSH supplies to the plugin; no DSH package version range is pinned. Refresh after a client updat
e; host-code updates need plugin reactivation or a DSH restart. A page refresh alone cannot replace
a loaded host module.
### Optional desktop companion
The always-on-top pet is on by default: an install without saved preferences starts the companion ri
ght away, so the pet floats above other windows. *Use page pet* turns it off; *Retry always-on-top p

et* restarts it after a failed start.
Use `DSH_PET_ELECTRON_PATH` (or `ELECTRON_PATH`) for an existi
ng Electron executable. The plugin also checks `$DSH_HOME/electron/electron.exe` on Windows (`electr
on` on Linux), the user npm installation, and legacy Windows install locations. No binary is downloa
ded automatically. macOS should use an explicit executable path.
The host's actual port is used automatically. `DSH_CAPYREP_BASE_URL` can override it with an exact l
oopback HTTP(S) origin, not a URL with credentials, paths or auth tokens. Remote/reverse-proxied ori
gins are deliberately not supported by this plugin's local-only route boundary.
The page pet is hidden **only after** the companion has decoded its image, fetched activity, and rep
orted ready. Missing Electron, a failed renderer, or a stale heartbeat keeps/restores the page fallb
ack. Some exclusive fullscreen applications can still cover a topmost window. Empty window backgroun
d is click-through; the artwork element and bubble are interactive rectangles.
## Controls
| Action | Result |

| Drag the pet | Move it; dragging does not dismiss results or open DSH |
| Ctrl / Cmd + wheel over

the pet | Resize, 50–250% (ordinary scrolling remains available) |
| Click, right-click, or Enter/Sp

ace on pet controls | Open controls |
| Click anywhere outside an open menu (or press Escape) | Dism

iss the pet menu — in the page pet and in the always-on-top companion |
| Details / Collapse | Toggl

e scrollable session details |
| Go to chat | Open the session the headline refers to (running, else
finished) via DSH workspace navigation; also in the pet menu. Page pet only — the always-on-top com

panion cannot drive the browser window |
| Pet menu → Open settings | Jump straight to the CapyRepor

ter section of DSH settings (also in the desktop companion menu) |
| Pet menu → Enable / Retry alway
s-on-top pet | Start the always-on-top companion, or retry it after a failed start, without leaving

the page pet |
| × in the bubble's top-right corner | Close the current bubble (new activity resurfa

ces it); after a run ends it also acknowledges the result. The pet menu keeps *Dismiss result* |
| D
rag any bubble edge/corner, arrow keys on the corner handle, or Ctrl + wheel over the bubble | Resiz
e the bubble (width 260–560, height 160–720 px), remembered per browser; buttons stay pinned to the

bottom edge and the details area scrolls when the bubble is short |
| Drag any edge/corner of the de
sktop bubble | Resize the always-on-top bubble; its window follows so the pet stays anchored above t

he bubble |
| Double-click a resize handle, or **Reset bubble size** in the pet menu | Restore the d

efault 360 px width and content-driven height |
| Mute 30 min | Silence only the bubble for the conf
igured duration (default 30 min); the pet/menu stay usable and unchanged activity returns when unmut

ed |
| Restore bubble | Show current activity again and end a mute early |
| Double-click desktop pe

t / Open DeepSeek Harness | Open the configured DSH origin |
| Escape | Close controls/details |

## Security and diagnostics
Plugin HTTP handlers are separate from DSH's SPA authentication gate. This plugin rejects cross-orig
in/opaque browser requests, non-loopback callers/Host headers and GET mutations; it does not expose
wildcard CORS. The desktop uses an activation-scoped capability held in its main process, a sandboxe
d renderer, restrictive CSP and an allowlisted IPC broker. See architecture for boundaries, includin
g what they do **not** protect against.
No telemetry or outbound service is used. Notifications and the always-on-top pet can expose session
titles/assistant previews on your screen; disable them in shared-screen environments.
